description: Machine-readable classification of every data asset tracked in this repository. DATA_PROVENANCE.md is the human-readable rendering of this file; scripts/check_public_repository_boundary.py fails CI when the two drift apart, when a path here is missing from disk, or when a tracked data file is absent from this manifest.

classes.SYNTHETIC: Hand-constructed fixture. Contains no real third-party asset. Regulatory text inside it is fictional placeholder content and is not authoritative — see DATA_PROVENANCE.md section 4.
classes.EMPTY_BY_DESIGN: Committed empty on purpose. Writing synthetic or model-generated records into it is a CI failure.
classes.SCHEMA: Structural definition only. Carries no business data.
classes.RUNTIME_EVIDENCE: Recorded observation of a real dependency on a single local host. Contains no corpus content, logs or credentials.
classes.GOVERNANCE: Review-tracker metadata. Records the state of outstanding human verification work. Asserts no regulatory conclusion of its own; every entry names what still has to be decided.

disclosure_vocabulary.record_marker: How a single record identifies itself when separated from this manifest. 'inline:<field>' means the named field travels inside every record, and CI verifies the field is present in every one. 'file' means one declaration at the top of the file covers the whole file. 'none' means a record carries no self-description, and record_marker_absent_reason explains why.
disclosure_vocabulary.regulatory_shaped_fields: Keys whose values quote a real regulation instrument or a limit-shaped concentration. A consumer building a redacted view, an external excerpt or a training export should treat exactly these keys as synthetic, because they are the ones that read as authoritative out of context.
disclosure_vocabulary.record_marker_absent_reason: Required whenever record_marker is 'none'. Silence is the defect this closes: an unstated gap reads as an oversight and cannot be tracked.

assets.purpose: real-service Qdrant validation checks; localhost endpoints only
provenance and compatibility record for the Qdrant validation
per-assertion review state for the regulatory-shaped fixture text; 15 entries, none verified

assets.record_marker_absent_reason: offline/finetune_qlora.py reads only instruction/input/output and drops unknown keys, so a per-record field would never reach the training template. Adding one would be a dataset change with no effect on the output that actually needs the label: the trained adapter. Tracked as open work; see DATA_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md section 1.3.
assets.regulatory_shaped_fields_evidence: 12 of 40 rows carry a limit-shaped value; 11 quote a named regulation; 3 carry both.

assets.record_marker_absent_reason: AnswerEvalSample.from_dict selects named fields into a frozen dataclass and silently drops unknown keys, so a per-record field would be discarded on load. The records also quote no limit value, only 2 of 12 name an instrument, and nothing is exported that carries the text. Tracked as open work; see DATA_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md section 1.3.
assets.regulatory_shaped_fields_evidence: 2 of 12 rows name a regulation instrument; 0 carry a limit-shaped value.

assets.purpose: retrieval and RAGAS evaluation fixture (301 rows)
assets.record_marker_absent_reason: Highest-value file and highest blast radius. Its sha256 is pinned in tests/validation/test_golden_set_evidence_docs.py and recorded in docs/validation/rag-eval-readiness.md as a measured 0/301 contract result; sample_id is derived from the line index; _sample_hash hashes the sorted contexts. A per-record field is therefore a dataset version change, not a metadata addition. Deliberately deferred and tracked; see DATA_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md section 1.3.
assets.regulatory_shaped_fields_evidence: 110 of 301 rows name a regulation instrument (contexts 91, answer 14, ground_truth 21, question 10); 116 carry a limit-shaped value (contexts 182, ground_truth 115, answer 78, question 5); 51 carry both. contexts is retrieval ground truth and question is the retrieval query, so neither may receive an inline marker without changing what is measured.

assets.regulatory_shaped_fields_evidence: 104 of 301 rows name a regulation instrument; 111 carry a limit-shaped value.
